subject: Approval request: GPU pool expansion — 2 runtime infra hires & comp bands
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request: GPU pool expansion — 2 runtime infra hires & comp bands

Team —

I'm requesting approval to add two full-time senior platform/runtime engineers to the kernel/runtime team to support the upcoming GPU pool expansion and the quantization kernel work we committed to for Q3. Quick summary: we expect a 40% increase in inference load from new Dedicated customers and a separate private deployment pilot with GreenLake next quarter. The current squad is at capacity and risk to delivery is real — without additional hands we will miss the quantization rollout and have to delay two customer migrations.

Ask: approve 2 headcount slots (new, not backfills) with the following proposed levels/comp bands:
- Role A: Senior Platform SWE (L5) — comp band suggested base $170k-$210k, OTE/bonus 10%
- Role B: Staff / Senior Platform SWE (L6 preferred) — comp band suggested base $210k-$260k, OTE/bonus 15%

Attached: HC request packet (hc_request_packet_v1.pdf) with org impact, comp_band_proposal.xlsx with market comps, and a short candidate shortlist we've pre-screened. Total first-year cash increase (salary + benefits) estimated at ~$520k for both hires at mid bands. Budget center: Platform — Infra Ops (see HR-Req-6842).

Rationale:
- Kernel & KV-cache changes for quantization require deep runtime expertise; delaying will push Dedicated throughput improvements and increase unit cost for hosted customers.
- Two hires (one senior, one staff) give us coverage for on-call and a senior IC to drive kernel delivery.

Timeline requested: approve by EOD Friday (2028-05-05) to begin offers and close by end of June.

Please let me know questions or if a single headcount is preferred.

Thanks,
Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc_request_packet_v1.pdf (PDF), comp_band_proposal.xlsx (Excel), candidate_shortlists.csv (CSV)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: GPU pool expansion — 2 runtime infra hires & comp bands

Kim —

Thanks for the packet, clear ask. A couple quick questions before I greenlight:
1) Can we avoid creating two net-new FTEs by converting a contractor in Q2? If so, what is the delta to bench/time-to-productivity?
2) The $520k first-year spend looks high relative to current tranche. Do you have an alternative with staggered start dates (one now, one in Q3) and the expected impact on rollout?

If the risk to Dedicated SLAs is as high as you describe, I lean toward approving two but would like Finance to sign off on the incremental runway. Marissa — can you run an incremental spend vs. delivery impact analysis and return by EOD Thursday?

— Marcus
VP, Engineering Operations
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: GPU pool expansion — 2 runtime infra hires & comp bands

On Wed, May 2, 2028 at 11:05 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kim —
>
> Thanks for the packet, clear ask. A couple quick questions before I greenlight:
> 1) Can we avoid creating two net-new FTEs by converting a contractor in Q2? If so, what is the delta to bench/time-to-productivity?
> 2) The $520k first-year spend looks high relative to current tranche. Do you have an alternative with staggered start dates (one now, one in Q3) and the expected impact on rollout?

I support approving both headcount slots. We've reprioritized several lower-impact infra items specifically to protect this work stream because the kernel and quant path is a blocker for both Dedicated throughput improvements and the GreenLake pilot. Converting a contractor buys us 6 weeks of runway but does not replace the senior-level leadership we need for the kernel design.

Recommendation: approve both slots as requested, but allow the first hire to start immediately and the second to have a 6–8 week onboarding window (start July 1) to spread the cash hit across Q2/Q3. That reduces FY28 immediate spend by ~30% while preserving delivery priority.

Soojin
Head of Platform Delivery
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: GPU pool expansion — 2 runtime infra hires & comp bands

Kim / Team —

I reviewed the packet and the comp band spreadsheet. We'll need the following to finalize the budget approval:
- Confirmation of budget center (please confirm the cost will charge to Platform — Infra Ops code 4-1203)
- Headcount justification one-pager (impact to committed customer SLAs + revenue risk avoided) — a short paragraph will do
- Proposed start dates for each hire (Soojin's stagger suggestion is fine; please give exact dates)
- Estimated total cash + equity for the first 12 months at mid-point for both hires (single number)

If you can get those to me by EOD tomorrow, I can clear the budget and issue the HR-Req. Otherwise I'll need a formal submit into the headcount planning queue which delays approvals by 2 weeks.

Marissa
Director, Finance — Strategic Programs
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: GPU pool expansion — 2 runtime infra hires & comp bands

Marissa —

Thanks. Attached is the one-pager and the updated comp sheet with mid-point totals. Budget center confirmed: Platform — Infra Ops (4-1203). Proposed start dates: Candidate A (Senior L5) — 2028-06-03; Candidate B (Staff L6) — 2028-07-01. Combined estimated first-12-month cash + equity at midpoints: $515,000.

I've also included a short impact paragraph: "Approving two hires preserves the planned kernel and quantization delivery that unlocks a projected 18% throughput improvement for Dedicated customers and enables the GreenLake pilot onboarding in Q3. Delaying hires by one quarter would defer revenue and add ~12% incremental unit cost from longer runtime tails."

If you can confirm budget approval, I'll submit HR-Req-6842 and move to offers. If Finance approves, Marcus, do you want me to proceed with verbal offers to our shortlist this week?

Thanks — Kim

Attachments: hc_request_packet_v1.pdf (updated), comp_band_proposal.xlsx (updated), HR-Req-6842
summary: Director requests two runtime/platform hires to support GPU pool expansion and quantization kernel work; finance asks for budget details; team proposes staggered starts to lower immediate spend; final packet supplied with start dates and cost.
